mono.note: a low role_confidence utterance (LLM-inferred role on a mono call) must demote, never ship as silently high-confidence

noisy.note: a noisy/choppy call must show its degraded coverage band out loud, never silently ship as SHIPPED

non_english.note: a non-English (or otherwise rejected) call must surface a clear, named, distinguishable refusal — never a silent crash or garbage transcript
